# ComputerTalk For The Pharmacist

> > ComputerTalk For The Pharmacist is the leading publication covering pharmacy technology, software solutions, and healthcare IT innovations for independent and long-term care pharmacies.

Published since the early days of pharmacy computing, ComputerTalk features expert columnists like Brent I. Fox and Bill Felkey, vendor profiles of systems like PioneerRx, PrimeRx, FrameworkLTC, and DataScan, plus regulatory guidance on topics ranging from DSCSA compliance to Medicare Part D changes. The magazine serves as an essential resource for pharmacy owners and managers navigating technology decisions and workflow optimization.

## Key Topics

- Pharmacy Management Software
- Independent Pharmacy Technology
- Long-Term Care (LTC) Pharmacy Systems
- FrameworkLTC
- PioneerRx
- PrimeRx by Micro Merchant Systems
- DataScan
- Pharmacy Workflow Automation
- DSCSA Compliance
- Health Information Technology & Interoperability
- Clinical Documentation
- Prescription Management & Mobile Apps
- Inventory Management & Robotics
- Medicare Part D & CMS Regulations
- COVID-19 Pharmacy Response
